fcc_description:
Given two DNA strands of equal length, return an array of indexes where the strands differ (mutations).

  • DNA strands are strings made up of the characters "A", "T", "C", and "G"
  • Return the indexes in ascending order
  • If there are no mutations, return an empty array
fcc_js_tests:
[{"text": "

detectMutations(\"ATCG\", \"ATGG\") should return [2].

", "testString": "assert.deepEqual(detectMutations(\"ATCG\", \"ATGG\"), [2]);"}, {"text": "

detectMutations(\"ATGCGTACGTTAGC\", \"ATGCATACGATTGC\") should return [4, 9, 11].

", "testString": "assert.deepEqual(detectMutations(\"ATGCGTACGTTAGC\", \"ATGCATACGATTGC\"), [4, 9, 11]);"}, {"text": "
